steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Butler, you're taking your annual leave tomorrow. You should go home early and get some rest.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Please do not worry, Young Master. I am on the last of my tasks for the day, and shall be finished in no time.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: More importantly, why are you up so late at night? You've worked overtime for days now. You need to rest when you can as well.

spans.text: up so late at night? You've worked overtime for days now. You need to rest when you can as well.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I was planning to, but... Father has been trying to expand his business in Columbia.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: And I think... I should make an effort to do something ahead of time too, to work with him.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: As I recall, he merely brought it up as an aside at the dinner table.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: If I wait for him to tell me formally, there'll be basically nothing left for me to do.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: *sigh*... You really have it too rough.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: It'll be worth it, if it means I can take over for my father in the future.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Goodness, look at the time. Bison, what are you talking to Butler about?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Nothing, Father. We were just discussing holiday plans.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Sir, has the young master told you his?

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Not a peep. He's been so busy lately I haven't even seen him much. So, any big plans, Bison?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Um... I want to learn something new. Or start preparing for my projects next year. I haven't thought it through yet, but I need to find something to do.

spans.text: Um... I want to learn something new. Or start preparing for my projects next year. I haven't thought it through yet, but I need to find

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: But it's a holiday...

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Bison, if you really must keep yourself busy, why don't you go see your friends at Penguin Logistics? I brought a lot of things back from Columbia. Bring them something as a present.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Alright. Of course, Father.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Great. Now get some rest. You've got an early day tomorrow, and Butler won't be here to help you. You'll need to prepare the presents yourself.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Yeah, I know. I can handle it on my own.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: I can stay to help you wrap your presents before I take my leave, if you like.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: No no no. You should head home and spend time with your family. You've worked so hard this whole year; you don't have to work overtime for me.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Besides... I'm sure Father is expecting more from me than just going to see some friends.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I've known the girls at Penguin Logistics for a while now. Sometimes I forget they're actually our business partners.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I think what he's trying to tell me is that relationships need to be maintained over the long-term, and that the work doesn't end just because we're friends now. I need to remember that.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Butler?

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Oh, nothing. I was just thinking back to when the lady of the house was still with us.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Exusiai, we're going on a picnic. What do you need all those guns for?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Because you never know if you'll be served a butter sandwich or a special surprise!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ugh, so heavy...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Croissant, why are you bringing all that food? Again, we're going on a picnic! We can't eat all that!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: No can do... It's sunny out. There's gotta be loads of other folks out picnickin'.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ain't no way... I'm missing... a business opportunity.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas, can you help me out here?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Oh, I tried. She wouldn't listen.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You know me. So long as there's money in it...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Nothing's... too heavy... for yer gal Croissant... Ugh!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: (Holy cow...)

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hey Bison. What are you doing here today?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Hello. Happy New Year.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I brought you girls some presents. I hope you like them.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Wow, what a pretty lamp.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh, Bison? Hehe, since yer here, why doncha come picnickin' with us?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hah, you just want someone to haul your wares.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: *cough* I appreciate the invitation, but I'm just stopping by to say hello, since I have some free time over the holidays.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But you've been so busy lately, and it's been so long since we've seen each other. Has it been that hectic at work?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Actually, we've already got everything sorted out. But I didn't want to slack off just because of the holiday.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I thought slacking off was the whole point of a holiday?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Right, right. And I got us this really pretty new picnic blanket just for this! Come on, Bison!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But I—

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hello, how may I help you?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Okay... I don't quite understand, but no problem. We'll take care of it. Yeah, okay. Bye.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Who was that?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The boss. The situation's changed. Looks like we'll have to cancel the picnic.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: No way, don't tell me...?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yup, sounds like we got that special surprise.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Anyway, I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but we officially have an urgent request on our hands.

steps.name: Sora & Exusiai & Croissant
steps.text: No—!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Huddle up. I have something to say.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sheesh, why so mysterious?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Their conversation is really heating up... I guess this is my cue to leave.)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Um, if you girls are busy, I think I'll be heading out.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Wait, Bison.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We need you for this job.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yes, you.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: First, go buy a CD at this record shop?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Er... Wouldn't Sora be a better pick for this? I don't know much about music.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Excuse me, do you carry any—

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Shh... Quiet, kid. We're all listening to our grooves here. Take whatever you want from the shelves. We have everything.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Any recommendations?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Most folks who come here don't need any. Just pick what you want, kid.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I'm an adult...

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Good. Then you can head on over there, too.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: What's in there?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Okay... sorry.
He put the headphones on.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Really? Great. I knew it.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: That's my favorite shop. The owner never bothers you with sales pitches or questions. He just leaves you alone and lets you find what you like in his massive collection.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Sometimes, when I'm getting stressed out from my performances, I stop by there to relax.
Sounds like a good place to catch a breather.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Trust me. He'll be absolutely relaxed in there.
Hold up...

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: What's wrong?
He set the headphones down.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Are you okay, sir?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Oh... Apparently I have way too many CDs in stock.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: That mountain of them was an accident waiting to happen. I wouldn't have gone near it, if I were you. How long have you been piling up CDs there?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: A year? Two? It's been too long... Couldn't be bothered to clean it up.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Sounds like you need someone to help you sort them out.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: ...I guess so?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (This must be what they wanted me to help out with... Sheesh... they could've been clearer with the job description.)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (I don't mind listening to music... but now's not the time.)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Let me take care of it. I used to be a mail sorter, and I've sorted things much more complicated than these CDs.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Kid, you...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Trust me. I'm a professional.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Uh... hold up, how are you gonna sort them?

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: What's going on inside the store? Hello? Hello?
...The pile of CDs came crashing down. He's helping clean them up.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: What about the music? Is he not listening to music?
He's going all-out with it. Music's probably the last thing on his mind.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Ugh... my shoulders hurt. I didn't expect him to have so many CDs.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I think I did pretty well with the sorting, though. It's been a long time, but I've still got it.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Let's see, what's my next job... Haggle the price down like mad at this weapon shop?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Why did they give me this one? Croissant seems like she'd be much better at this.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: How'd it go? He inside?
Yeah.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Heh, last time I drove the price down so much they blacklisted me and don't let me in no more. But heck, ain't no skin off my back. I got other ways.
I'm not so sure this is what the client had in mind.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Aww, you don't think hagglin' helps ya relax? You rack yer brains to argue with the shopkeep and snatch victory in the end. It's a real thrill.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Just trust me. He's gonna be feelin' mighty relaxed, after this.
Heh, I sure hope so. That'd get this over with quickly.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: What are you buying, kiddo?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Hold on. I have a shopping list.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Hmm... Hoo. That's quite a long list.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I'll need one of everything on here. I'll take them as soon as you have everything packed and ready. Thanks.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Alright. Here's the invoice. 160 grand in total. Cash or card?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (That's pretty reasonable... Do I really have to haggle this down?)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Oh well... It's what the job calls for.)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Do you think you could you give me a discount?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: No can do, kiddo. We're already known for our low prices around here.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Never mind, then. I'll go to another store.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Tsk, fine. You're buying in bulk. I'll give you 10% off.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (10%... Is that 'mad' enough?)

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: I'm selling them at cost already. Don't push it.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (I'm not the best at business negotiation, but maybe I could try to put what little I know into haggling.)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Come on, let's be honest here. This is nowhere close to cutting into your bottom line.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: And what would you know, punk? All these parts are imported straight from Columbia.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Sure, they have stickers from Columbian brands, but the manufacturing immediately gives it away that they were made in Bolívar.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: The prices you're asking are way above the actual cost. By my estimate, these things are worth no more than 60 thousand LMD.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Beastshit. I sell the real deal here!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: You're sure?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Then you were probably scammed when you ordered them. My family's logistics network has been delivering for this company for years. I remember every lot, every model, and every manufacturing plant of theirs.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: You shouldn't trust just anyone. You can't do business that way.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: You calling me stupid?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I mean, the other possibility is that you're not stupid, but actually pretty smart. After all, there's a huge difference in price between knockoffs and the genuine article.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: ...What are you getting at?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: 80 thousand. You'll be earning more than a fair profit, after expenses.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: That's just cruel...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Please don't cry.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: *sobs*... Too cruel.
Someone just stepped out.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Hah, and I bet that someone's stress-free and fulla confidence, pride, and a whole lotta parts.
No, it's the shopkeeper.
He ran out of the store crying.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: I gotta say, what's with the crazy schemes you two came up with?

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: You want him relaxed and destressed? You just gotta par-tay! There's no easier way than partying hard!
Sorry, could you repeat that? This crowd's pretty noisy.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: bI SAID. HAVING HIM GO TO A PARTY IS THE BEST WAY FOR HIM TO DESTRESS!!
Ugh... Now you're being loud.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: You're at the biggest party in Lungmen on New Year's Eve! I was worried you couldn't hear me.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: What's the matter? Is he there?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (I wonder if I could've haggled for an even lower price...)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Looks like I still have a ways to go to when it comes to negotiation.)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oof! S-So many people.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (I still have one last task to do... Deliver a present to somebody at this party.)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But there are so many people here. How am I supposed to find them?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (They're wearing an iron mask and a menacing cape, both impervious to all kinds of weapons... This isn't a character from a kung fu novel, is it?)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: *sigh*... A Messenger's job is to brave difficulties. I can do this.
He's pushing into the crowd. You sure he's not going to find anyone matching that description?

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Of course not! I took it straight from a novel I used to read, The Iron Swordsman. What are the odds someone would be cosplaying as him on New Year's Eve?

spans.text: Of course not! I took it straight from a novel I used to read,
. What are the odds someone would be cosplaying as him on New Year's Eve?

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Not like it's Sauin.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...They aren't pulling my leg, are they? Who would dress up like that in this crowd?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Maybe I should go back and double-check with them.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: No way?!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: They weren't lying! He's really here!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Sir? Sir! Please stop.

steps.name: Armor-clad Knight
steps.text: Hm? Who are you?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Hello, sir. I'm a Messenger. I have a package for you. Please sign for it.

steps.name: Armor-clad Knight
steps.text: Interesting. A package for me, delivered to this place?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Right. They had me look for the recipient in the middle of such a big party. I almost thought there had to be a misunderstanding. But thank goodness I found you.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Please go over the contents and sign for it.

steps.name: Armor-clad Knight
steps.text: I wonder what it is. Never expected to get a package while I'm out of town. What delivery company do you work—

steps.name: Armor-clad Knight
steps.text: (*gulp*)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Sir?

steps.name: Armor-clad Knight
steps.text: (Clenches fist)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Armor-clad Knight
steps.text: (Shudders)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Armor-clad Knight
steps.text: Who are you?
Too bad... He found someone that fit the description.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: What? No way!
There's a Kazimierzian knight in the crowd.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: ...What? How's that possible?
What did you put in the package? The guy looked like he saw a ghost the moment he opened it.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Hmm... I don't really remember. I just grabbed whatever and stuffed it in there.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Let me see... Looks like Croissant ordered a bunch of special arrowheads, so I grabbed one.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Good thing there are bushes here...)

steps.name: Armor-clad Knight
steps.text: Weird... I saw the kid heading this way... but I don't see him anywhere...

steps.name: Armor-clad Knight
steps.text: Shit... Where'd he go?

steps.name: Armor-clad Knight
steps.text: What did I even do? And how did the Armorless Union find me all the way out here in Lungmen...?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Phew... Is he gone?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Why did he attack all of a sudden?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oh well. Never mind. I finally lost him...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I'm exhausted... I-I need to find a place to catch a breather.
Bison leans against a tree and thinks about everything that has happened today, in an attempt to come up with anything that could explain this absurd turn of events.
But right now, he isn't very keen on thinking too hard.
Perhaps the chilly New Year's Eve breeze has left his mind completely blank.
Perhaps the strange events that unfolded throughout the day have numbed his thought process.
Or perhaps... he simply doesn't want to think, and just wants to lean against the tree.
That is, until a ball comes tumbling toward his feet, rousing him from his daze.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Hey, buddy. Kick the ball back over here, will you?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Hello? What're you blanking out for? Wanna join us?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: There are no goals here, and barely any grass... How would we even play?

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: You just play.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But there are no lines on the ground. How do we keep score? How do we determine if anyone's breaking the rules?

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Rules? We don't care about rules.
Bison suddenly recalls that it's been a very long time since he played football.
His father forced him to join the family business before he had even graduated. And he had to sacrifice a lot for it.
He lifts his head up and gazes at the child in the distance waiting for him to kick the ball back.
They have no grass field to play on, but a dirt pit is more than enough.
They have no goals, but a couple of tin cans will do the trick.
They kick erratically, and their play is all over the place, but what does it matter as long as it's fun?
Bison suddenly realizes that it has been a very long time since he last did anything just for fun.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Pffhaha––

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Is this the answer? The answer to everything?)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Never mind. It doesn't matter. I've got something more important to deal with.)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Hey, count me in!

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Then kick the ball back over here!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Kid, I used to be my school's ace player. Are you sure you can catch it?
In the end, he's still a kid...

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Hey! How come it took you so long to say anything? What's he doing?
Alright, our job here is done.
I'm heading back.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Hey, you're the only one there. Tell us what's going on! Hey!
I'll see you later. I need to report to the client.

steps.name: Comms
steps.text: Hey—

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Mr. Eurill, you sure gave us a difficult problem.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Still, we managed to successfully finish the job.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: So he's playing football, huh?

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: It's been years since he played. And with a couple of kids not much younger than him. Haha.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: I know, I know. He's still a child... Thank you for your work, ladies. I will come visit and bring all of you gifts in due time.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: ...Why didn't I tell him myself?

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Good question... I wish I could've.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Alas, I couldn't...
